description:
🏜️ Abandoned and buried in debt, pastry seller Scarlett rescues a dying little mermaid Pearl in the desert mud. Pearl’s tears turn into precious pearls, attracting her greedy stepmother and cold black-market smugglers. With her former rival Lucas helping her, Scarlett chooses kindness over wealth, fighting to send Pearl back to the ocean.
#DesertMermaid #FantasyDrama #FoundFamily
